lines.text: The elevator opens on a dark room.
The handful of light sources cast the rest of the space in shadow.
The only sound is the regular sound of machines.
In the corner of that dark, silent space is a pair of severely devastated twins.
You're Hansel and Gretel, right?

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Who...?

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Oh... Prince.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Gretel and I have never met you before.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: But I know you. You're Prince.
Yeah.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Ugh. Prince?

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Are you here to see our family?
Yeah.
The twins walk silently. I follow behind them.
Soon, we arrive at a room.
The air is so cold I can't feel any signs of life.
Cinderella, Grave, and Siren are lying inside.
They're each lying inside a device that resembles a coffin.
I stand in front of them.
None of them move an inch.
Hey, guys.
Thanks for coming.
We were able to win thanks to you.
We defeated the Queen and brought the Ark to the surface.
Thank you. Seriously...

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Gretel and I...

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: are happy they all came to look for us.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: We're happy we all fought the Queen together.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: It was scary, but also wasn't scary because we were all together.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: But...

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Now it's scary.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: I'm scared Cinderella, Siren, and Grave will never wake up again.
Don't worry.
I promise they'll wake up. I'm going to make it happen.
As everyone's prince, I'm going to make it happen.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Can we trust you, Prince?
Yes. Trust me.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Gretel and I know how to save everyone.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Ber can fix them. She knows how.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: But we can't go all the way there.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Help us, Prince.
Okay. I'll help you.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Let's go right now.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Gretel and I know the way. Let's go right now.

lines.speaker: gretel
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Gretel?

lines.speaker: gretel
lines.text: We can't go now.

lines.speaker: gretel
lines.text: We just finished fighting the Queen. No one here has time.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: We have to go even if no one has time. Cinderella, Siren, and Grave might die.

lines.speaker: gretel
lines.text: They won't die.

lines.speaker: gretel
lines.text: Right, Prince?
... Right. Of course not.
Isn't that right, Syuen?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Right. They won't die.

lines.speaker: gretel
lines.text: Hear that? Let's wait a bit, Hansel.

lines.speaker: gretel
lines.text: Nobody's going to die.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: ... Okay.

lines.speaker: gretel
lines.text: Let's get some rest, Hansel.

lines.speaker: gretel
lines.text: We need to rest.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: ... Okay.
Gretel supports Hansel as they walk away.
They look as though they might collapse at any moment.
The moment I walk over to lend them a hand, Gretel turns and looks back.
With a small nod, she leaves for the break room.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Ugh, they wouldn't say a word all this time,

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: but the second their prince shows up, they start talking.
Syuen.
Can you explain what happened to them?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Look at see for yourself. They're alive, but that's it.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: They got completely messed up.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: I heard you contacted Burningum directly.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: If they'd taken any longer, there would've been no hope for them.
Tell me what happened.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: *Sigh...* Fine.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: This white rust bucket—
Cinderella.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: What do I care about their names? This white rust bucket—
It's Cinderella, Syuen.
I point to Cinderella.
Cinderella.
I point to Siren.
Little Mermaid. But she also goes by Siren.
I point to Grave.
Grave.
Remember them.
Please, remember.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Fine, fine. Just shut up about it already.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: So for Cinderella...

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: As you can see, only her head and body are left.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: And since she used to be a Heretic, she doesn't have NIMPH, which means we can't build her a new body.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: And since we don't know what her body was made of, we can't fix it.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: She's unconscious, too, so she can't self-repair.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: As for Little Mermaid...

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: All functions above the neck have stopped.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Her neck in particular is completely mangled.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: I have no idea what she did, but she overworked her brain, so not even her NIMPH is working.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Next, there's Grave.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: She's in the worst condition.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Her brain is burned.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Her brain was already a mess to begin with. Her NIMPH is messed up, like someone was rummaging around in there.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: And in that condition, she overused her brain.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Apparently she used a Harmony Cube for added computational power.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: But a human brain could never handle that much in the first place.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Her brain would've burned up and killed her before long anyway.
What are you saying?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: ... She's dead.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: She's as good as dead.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: The others all have their brains intact, so we can at least find a solution,

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: but there's no helping her.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: It's better to let her go.
I won't allow that.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Yeah, fine. It costs about the same to store three as it does two.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: If you can find a solution, Prince, I'll help you.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: I'm you're servant now, after all. Isn't that right?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: As for the twins...
Hansel and Gretel.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Yeah, yeah. Hansel and Gretel are in bad shape too.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Maybe their prince can talk them into getting repaired.
Okay. I'll try.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Let's go. There's one more for you to see.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: That rust bucket who rides around on a horse.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Oh, it's you.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: What a surprise. Even this one starts talking now that you're here.
Chime.

lines.speaker: kilo
lines.text: Oh, hi.

lines.speaker: talos
lines.text: Hello.
Kilo, T.A.L.O.S.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Her Highness is in here.
I see Crown lying in a device.
My heart drops when I see the Crown Kingdom flag covering her up to her face.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Oh, don't worry.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: She's alive. But her wounds are so severe that I covered her for modesty's sake.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Seeing how she'll soon wake up and command the world, there's no reason for others to see her like this.
Yeah, that's true.
Syuen, how's Crown?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: She's another pain in my neck.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: She just got hit a lot. Like way too much.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: The damage is severe, and there's no way to fix her.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Nobody's even tried.
Why not?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: First of all, you.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Where did you meet her?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Ugh, of course you go quiet again.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Hey, Heavy Gram.

lines.speaker: kilo
lines.text: Y-yes?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Do you know?

lines.speaker: kilo
lines.text: I... don't.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: What a pain.
Tell us what happened.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: She wasn't made in the Ark.
What?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Some things are similar, but still oddly different.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: You know the scrap metal lying in the next room? Cinderella and whoever else.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: They were at least made in the same style as the Ark's tech.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: They're old, but the technology has roots in the Ark.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Meanwhile, this one is completely different. There are some similarities in the structure, but everything else is completely different.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: The only thing we can do for her is patch her up.
So you're saying she's not a Nikke from the Ark?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Nope. I have no idea where she's from.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: The craftsmanship is too precise for it to be made by just one person,

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: and more than anything,

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: She doesn't have any NIMPH.
She doesn't?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: There aren't any signs of her having been corrupted and then cured with Vapaus either.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: It was just never there.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: She wasn't made with it.
What in the world...?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Also, that T.A.V:A. she was riding.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: That wasn't made with the Ark's tech, either. It's something completely different.
Chime.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: I don't know anything.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: All I did was meet and then serve Her Highness.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: I don't know about any of that.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: If you're not going to tell us anything, then take her and get out of here.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: We're spending a lot of money just to keep her alive, so if you're not going to—

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: I really don't know anything!

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: I don't. I know nothing.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: I know nothing about Her Highness.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: I may be the king's secretary and chief aide of the Crown Kingdom, but I don't know anything.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: I don't need to know. Serving her is enough.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: We can't fix her without information.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: ... But that's why I took the deal.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: In exchange for handing over the superfood seeds, you said you would fix her.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: I already talked about it with that deputy chief fellow.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Didn't you hear?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: I heard, but I can't do anything without information!

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: That's on you!

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: If you don't keep your promise, all the superfood in Crown Kingdom will burn and vanish!

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Famine will come to the Ark, and all will perish!

lines.speaker: kilo
lines.text: Chime!
Chime!

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: What?! Why am I supposed to care? Why should I care about what happens to the Ark and all of—
*Slap!*

lines.speaker: kilo
lines.text: Snap out of it!

lines.speaker: kilo
lines.text: Do you really think Crown would be proud of you if she saw you acting this way?

lines.speaker: kilo
lines.text: Do you think she'd be pleased that you're threatening the lives of everyone on the Ark?

lines.speaker: kilo
lines.text: I'm sure she'd be so proud her secretary put everyone's lives in jeopardy just to save her!

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: ... I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: I never should've said such a thing...

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: I... need some rest. I'm sorry.
Chime trudges away.
Kilo.

lines.speaker: kilo
lines.text: *Sniffle!*

lines.speaker: kilo
lines.text: Commander...! We, we...!

lines.speaker: kilo
lines.text: What were we fighting for...?

lines.speaker: kilo
lines.text: Look at what happened to Crown...! And Marian! She turned into a moon, or whatever...!

lines.speaker: kilo
lines.text: And Chime...! Look at her!

lines.speaker: kilo
lines.text: Everything we did...! It was all just meaningless...!
No, Kilo. It wasn't meaningless at all.
I'm going to make everything right.
I'll prove to you that it wasn't meaningless after all.
Trust me, Kilo.

lines.speaker: kilo
lines.text: ... Okay. I'm trusting you.

lines.speaker: kilo
lines.text: I-I'm sorry. I didn't mean to get all upset and cry...
It's okay. I get it.

lines.speaker: kilo
lines.text: Don't worry about Chime. I'll talk to her.

lines.speaker: kilo
lines.text: You must be busy. You should get going.

lines.speaker: kilo
lines.text: T.A.L.O.S. and I will be here.

lines.speaker: kilo
lines.text: Go on.

lines.speaker: talos
lines.text: Kilo needs some time to be alone.

lines.speaker: talos
lines.text: I'm sorry, but I ask that you leave.
Okay. See you later, guys.

lines.speaker: kilo
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: talos
lines.text: See you next time.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Are you crying?
Shut up.
What are you going to do?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: To be honest, keeping them alive is the best we can do right now.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: We're at our technological limit.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: So... *Sigh*

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: I'm going to take them to M.M.R.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: I have to officially ask for their help. That's all I can do. Though, I don't know if even that will work.
Let's get help from D.E.E.P.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: ... You know about them too, huh?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Well, I guess that makes sense, since you're the Commander of that firepower-loving rust bucket.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Yeah, we're gonna use D.E.E.P.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: The firepower-loving rust bucket has the key, right? Then we'll figure something out.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: It's embarrassing, but when dealing with unknown technology, we have to use unknown technology.
Okay. I'm trusting you.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Yeah, yeah. Just leave it to me.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: You should get going. The rust buckets won't shut up when you're around.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Your squad is at the Command Center.
Syuen.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: What?
Let me say this just in case. If you do anything to hurt them under the guise of helping them,
I won't let you get away with it.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Oh no! I'm so scared I might just wet myself!
Syuen walks to the treatment room.
I walk toward the elevator myself.
As I go, I look at the break room where Hansel and Gretel are.
Through a crack in the door,
I see them fast asleep in each other's arms.
Tears stream down their cheeks as they sleep.
